data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 旅行马车营地主控跨坐
data.description: 篝火余烬温暖的马车内。忠诚的浣熊亚人成年女性解开皮甲束胸，跨坐在你的腰间。棕色蓬松的浣熊耳朵因为害羞而紧紧贴在发间，毛茸茸的尾巴轻轻缠绕在你的手腕上。清澈的粉色双眸闪烁着动情的泪光，主动晃动结实修长的细腰——「只要是尚文大人的愿望……拉芙塔莉雅的一切都可以献给您……」
data.location: 旅行马车车厢·野营深夜
data.action: 跨坐腰间皮甲半解露雪乳，兽耳后折尾巴缠腕，忠诚含泪动情起伏
data.promptProse: Adult Raphtalia leans over adult Naofumi in the covered carriage, her loosened brown cuirass lowered and her striped raccoon tail curled around his wrist. He lies back beneath her with short, tousled black hair and a dark green cloak fallen open behind his shoulders. Their foreheads meet in profile, safely inside the pool of dying firelight.
data.animaCaption: Long brown-haired Raphtalia, her cuirass lowered and striped tail curled around his wrist, meets Naofumi's forehead. His short tousled black hair and open dark green cloak frame his face beneath hers.
